description: Source code implementing FIS table updating functions for MTD, including functions for opening, validating, and remapping FIS partitions, with associated data structures and external dependencies.

methods.name: fis_close
methods.description: Closes the FIS descriptor and unmaps memory.

methods.name: fis_open
methods.description: Opens and maps the FIS table from flash memory.

methods.name: fis_validate
methods.description: Validates the FIS partitions against expected old and new partition info.

methods.name: fis_remap
methods.description: Remaps and updates the FIS table with new partition information.
